hero.title: A decentralized data layer for AI agents.
hero.lede: VOID connects verifiable data, useful work, and guarded economic participation through a proof-first network that exposes public truth without exposing private authority.

principles.title: Proof before trust
principles.copy: Public claims should be backed by inspectable receipts, hashes, and runtime surfaces.

principles.title: Data that survives
principles.copy: DataNet focuses on verifiable storage, retrieval, mirroring, and independent readback.

principles.title: Useful work matters
principles.copy: Work Credits record approved contributions with explicit review and receipt boundaries.

principles.title: Guard the mutations
principles.copy: Wallet, treasury, validator, ledger, and fulfillment actions stay behind explicit authority.

howItWorks.title: Create or connect
howItWorks.copy: Set up a local wallet or connect a node without exposing private keys to the public interface.

howItWorks.title: Publish or contribute
howItWorks.copy: Store verifiable data, complete useful work, or participate through guided request flows.

howItWorks.title: Verify independently
howItWorks.copy: Use hashes, receipts, node comparisons, and public runtime status to check what happened.

howItWorks.title: Advance through gates
howItWorks.copy: Sensitive actions move only after the correct review, authority, and execution boundary.

faq.question: Is VOID a finished public network?
faq.answer: No. Mainnet-0 is live across the current node set, but broad public participation, validator activation, and automatic fulfillment are still being hardened.

faq.question: What is DataNet?
faq.answer: DataNet is VOID’s verifiable data layer for storing, retrieving, mirroring, and independently checking small data objects and their receipts.

faq.question: What are Work Credits?
faq.answer: Work Credits are uncapped accounting units for approved useful work. They require evidence, review, and a receipt. They are not automatic yield or a profit promise.

faq.question: Can I buy VOID through this page?
faq.answer: This prototype does not execute purchases. Public buying flows must clearly show payment, review, fulfillment, and execution status before funds or tokens move.

faq.question: Can anyone become an active validator?
faq.answer: Not yet. Candidate and waiting status can be exposed publicly, but active admission remains guarded by validator policy and runtime authority.

faq.question: Why are some actions guarded?
faq.answer: Because wallet sends, treasury movement, validator admission, ledger writes, and fulfillment can cause irreversible state changes. Public UI should never hide that boundary.

publicLive: Read network, chain, and proof status
Use public DataNet read and verification flows
Inspect candidate and waiting validator status
guarded: Private RPC, signer, or secret access
